Mit unserem modularen Hardware- und Softwareansatz denken wir das Prinzip neu: Wir machen automatisierte Versorgung flexibel anpassbar, datengest\u00fctzt und ressourcenschonend. Damit schaffen wir echten Mehrwert im Alltag \u2013 von der smarten Snack-Station bis zur einladenden, vollautomatisierten 24\/7-Micro-Lobby in Hotels.<\/p><p>Hinter Modumat stehen wir: <strong>Raphael und Frederik<\/strong>, zwei Informatik-Masterstudenten an der Hochschule Darmstadt (h_da). Unser erster Prototyp l\u00e4uft bereits erfolgreich im Live-Betrieb bei einem Pilotkunden, und unsere Vision wurde j\u00fcngst mit der <strong>D\u00f6rte-W\u00f6rner-Innovationsf\u00f6rderung<\/strong> ausgezeichnet. Da wir im Fr\u00fchjahr unseren Master abschlie\u00dfen, gehen wir nun gemeinsam den n\u00e4chsten Schritt: Wir beantragen das <strong>EXIST-Gr\u00fcnderstipendium<\/strong>, um Modumat als nachhaltig wachsendes Vollzeit-Startup (GmbH) aufzubauen.<\/p><p>Unsere Technologie steht auf einem stabilen Fundament. <strong>Jetzt fehlst du uns als 3. Kernteammitglied \u2013 die strategische, kommunikative und wirtschaftliche Perspektive f\u00fcr unser Gr\u00fcndungsteam!<\/strong><\/p><h3>Was du bei Modumat bewegst<\/h3><p>Als kaufm\u00e4nnische und kommunikative S\u00e4ule unseres Teams verbindest du unsere Technologie mit den Menschen und M\u00e4rkten, die sie brauchen:<\/p><ul><li><p><strong>Markenaufbau & B2B-Kommunikation:<\/strong> Du entwickelst unsere Positionierungsstrategie, verleihst Modumat eine starke Stimme und machst unsere L\u00f6sung bei relevanten B2B-Zielgruppen sichtbar (\u00fcber LinkedIn, Branchen-Events, gezieltes Storytelling und Kampagnen).<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Fokus Hospitality & G\u00e4steerlebnis:<\/strong> Du tauchst tief in die Welt der Hotellerie ein (z. B. moderne 24\/7-Lobby-Konzepte, smarter Minibar-Ersatz, Entlastung des Hotelpersonals) und gestaltest gemeinsam mit Entscheidungstr\u00e4ger*innen der Branche L\u00f6sungen, die G\u00e4ste und Hotelteams gleicherma\u00dfen begeistern.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Partnerschaften & Kundenbeziehungen:<\/strong> Du baust nachhaltige Beziehungen zu B2B-Partnern auf (Hotels, Coworking-Spaces, moderne Gastgeber) und gewinnst gemeinsam mit uns erste Pilotpartner sowie <em>Letters of Intent (LOIs)<\/em> f\u00fcr den EXIST-Antrag.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Gesch\u00e4ftsmodell & EXIST-Antrag:<\/strong> Du \u00fcbernimmst die Verantwortung f\u00fcr den wirtschaftlichen Teil unserer Gr\u00fcndungsreise \u2013 von der Markt- und Zielgruppenanalyse \u00fcber faire Pricing-Modelle bis hin zur Finanzplanung im Rahmen des EXIST-Stipendiums.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Webpr\u00e4senz & Au\u00dfenwirkung:<\/strong> Du gestaltest unseren Auftritt (Website, Pitch Decks, Kommunikationsmaterial) so, dass aus innovativer Technik verst\u00e4ndliche, einladende Mehrwerte f\u00fcr unsere Kund*innen werden.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h3>Was du mitbringst<\/h3><p><em>(Hinweis: Du musst noch nicht in jedem einzelnen Punkt jahrelange Erfahrung haben \u2013 viel wichtiger ist uns deine Begeisterung, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen!)<\/em><\/p><ul><li><p><strong>Studienhintergrund:<\/strong> Du studierst BWL, Marketing, Hospitality-\/Tourismus-Management, International Business, Kommunikationsmanagement, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ein verwandtes Fach (kurz vor dem Masterabschluss oder bereits abgeschlossen).<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Gesp\u00fcr f\u00fcr Hospitality & Service (gro\u00dfes Plus):<\/strong> Du kennst die Dynamik der Hotellerie oder Gastronomie (z. B. Personalmangel, G\u00e4stebed\u00fcrfnisse, 24\/7-Service) aus Praktika, Werkstudentent\u00e4tigkeiten oder deinem Netzwerk \u2013 oder du hast gro\u00dfe Lust, diese spannende Branche mit sinnstiftender Technologie zu unterst\u00fctzen.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Kommunikationsst\u00e4rke & Kundenfokus:<\/strong> Du h\u00f6rst Kund*innen genau zu, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und kannst komplexe Produkte empathisch, klar und \u00fcberzeugend vermitteln.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Offenheit f\u00fcr Tech & moderne KI-Tools:<\/strong> Du musst keine Zeile Code schreiben. Wichtig ist, dass du neugierig auf digitale Innovationen bist und moderne KI-Tools (wie ChatGPT, Canva\/Design-Tools oder Recherche-Tools) gerne nutzt, um dir den Arbeitsalltag kreativ und effizient zu erleichtern.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Gestaltungswille & Teamgeist:<\/strong> Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, sch\u00e4tzt aber genauso den engen Austausch im Team, um gemeinsam Ideen weiterzuentwickeln.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h3>Was dich bei uns erwartet<\/h3><ul><li><p><strong>Gr\u00fcnden auf echter Augenh\u00f6he:<\/strong> Du kommst nicht als Angestellte*r dazu, sondern als vollwertige Co-Founderin bzw. vollwertiger Co-Founder. Wir treffen Entscheidungen gemeinsam und legen gro\u00dfen Wert auf eine offene, wertsch\u00e4tzende und transparente Teamkultur.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Finanzielle Sicherheit & faire Anteile:<\/strong> \u00dcber das EXIST-Gr\u00fcnderstipendium erh\u00e4ltst du nach Bewilligung bis zu <strong>2.500 \u20ac\/Monat<\/strong>, um dich ohne finanziellen Druck auf das Startup zu konzentrieren. Zudem erh\u00e4ltst du eine faire, transparente Beteiligung (Equity) an der gemeinsamen GmbH.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Flexibilit\u00e4t & Work-Life-Balance:<\/strong> Ob in unserem sch\u00f6nen, ausgestatteten Projektraum an der h_da (Geb\u00e4ude D22) oder flexibel im Homeoffice \u2013 wir richten unsere Arbeitsweise so ein, dass sie zu unserem Leben passt.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Ein verl\u00e4ssliches Fundament:<\/strong> Du startest nicht bei null. Technik, Prototyp und erste F\u00f6rderungen sind bereits da \u2013 und wir (Raphael & Frederik) stehen dir als verl\u00e4ssliche, hilfsbereite Partner bei allen technischen Fragen jederzeit den R\u00fccken frei.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Starkes Netzwerk & Mentoring:<\/strong> Rundum-Support durch YUBIZZ!, das Startup-Zentrum der Hochschule Darmstadt (Workshops, Gr\u00fcndungsf\u00f6rderung & \u00d6kosystem), sowie individuelles Mentoring und Sparring durch unseren Gr\u00fcndercoach Prof. Dr. Michael von R\u00fcden.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h3>Hast du Lust, Modumat gemeinsam mit uns gro\u00df zu machen?<\/h3><p>Wenn du dich in vielen Punkten wiederfindest \u2013 auch wenn vielleicht nicht jeder einzelne Haken zu 100 % sitzt \u2013, freuen wir uns riesig, von dir zu h\u00f6ren!<\/p><p>Schreib uns einfach eine kurze, unkomplizierte Nachricht mit deinem LinkedIn-Profil oder Lebenslauf. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at &lt;u&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;http:\/\/grafana.com&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;grafana.com&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; and follow us on &lt;u&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/company\/grafana-labs\/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;LinkedIn&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/u&gt; and &lt;u&gt;&lt;span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/twitter.com\/grafana&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;X&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;u&gt;.&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You may not meet every requirement, and that\u2019s okay. If this role excites you, we\u2019d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Opportunity:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As Senior Engineering Manager, you\u2019ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;You\u2019ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups\u2014always with strong code review and quality standards. You&#39;ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You\u2019ll Be Doing:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be accountable for the performance of &lt;strong&gt;two&lt;\/strong&gt; distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead improvements across Grafana and R&amp;amp;D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana\u2019s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Makes You a Great Fit&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bonus Points For&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Compensation &amp;amp; Rewards:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR &lt;span data-sheets-root=&quot;1&quot;&gt;124,571&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-sheets-root=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;- EUR &lt;span data-sheets-root=&quot;1&quot;&gt;149,485&lt;\/span&gt;. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs&#39; success. We believe in shared outcomes\u2014RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em data-stringify-type=&quot;italic&quot;&gt;*Compensation ranges are country specific. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&amp;nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI&quot;&gt;Co-create the future with us&lt;\/a&gt; as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;*&lt;em&gt;Fortune 500\u00ae is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you&#39;ll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab&#39;s most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group&#39;s success within it. You&#39;ll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You&#39;ll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security &amp;amp; Compliance, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI\/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI &amp;amp; Competitive, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We&#39;ll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you&#39;ll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer&#39;s first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of government\u2011funded programs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab\u2019s interests are represented and understood&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial\u2011policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public\u2011sector forums to strengthen the company\u2019s visibility and credibility&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as Operating in close alignment with the Hamburg team and broader EU stakeholders, the Director establishes strategic patch goals, accurate financial forecasting, and seller development while through regular operating cadences and performance reviews.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner closely with the Hamburg sales leadership and wider EU teams to drive national agency development and product Experience with MEMS timing is strongly preferred.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated success leading and delivering complex MEMS development programs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands\u2011on technical credibility across MEMS design, fabrication, characterization, and modeling.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong technical and business judgment with the ability to innovate, design experiments, and interpret complex data.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with finite element simulation tools (COMSOL, ANSYS) and data processing tools (Matlab, Python).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of programing languages, circuits, metrology equipment, and methods&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Passion for execution excellence, ownership, delivering exceptional results&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Compensation Range:&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(224, 62, 45);&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals\u2014reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they&#39;d improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI&#39;s mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;10&quot;&gt;As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI&#39;s CAIO, a T\u00fcbingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2 id=&quot;the-problem-evalops&quot; class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;12&quot;&gt;The problem: EvalOps&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;13&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;15&quot;&gt;We will explore&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;EvalOps&lt;\/strong&gt;: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;17&quot;&gt;These questions will guide the initial work:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;18&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;18&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Regression suites&lt;\/strong&gt;: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;19&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Coverage estimation&lt;\/strong&gt;: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;20&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Live monitoring&lt;\/strong&gt;: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;21&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Eval analysis&lt;\/strong&gt;: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2 id=&quot;the-role&quot; class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;24&quot;&gt;The role&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;26&quot;&gt;As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;27&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;27&quot;&gt;Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;28&quot;&gt;Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;29&quot;&gt;Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;30&quot;&gt;Communicate decisions and learning clearly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;31&quot;&gt;Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;32&quot;&gt;Code and build end to end.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;34&quot;&gt;This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2 id=&quot;three-pillars-different-passions&quot; class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;36&quot;&gt;Three pillars, different passions&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;table class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;38&quot;&gt;\n&lt;thead class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;38&quot;&gt;\n&lt;tr class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;38&quot;&gt;\n&lt;th style=&quot;text-align: left;&quot;&gt;Pillar&lt;\/th&gt;\n&lt;th style=&quot;text-align: left;&quot;&gt;Driving question&lt;\/th&gt;\n&lt;th style=&quot;text-align: left;&quot;&gt;Possible EvalOps focus&lt;\/th&gt;\n&lt;\/tr&gt;\n&lt;\/thead&gt;\n&lt;tbody class=&quot;code-line&quot; A difficult question captures your curiosity. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2 id=&quot;what-you-will-gain&quot; class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;60&quot;&gt;What you will gain&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;61&quot;&gt;\n&lt;li class=&quot;code-line&quot; data-line=&quot;61&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Industry insight&lt;\/strong&gt;. This role offers the opportunity to work with numerous departments and collaborate with many different stakeholders.&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How You\u2019ll Find Success&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions that are applicable to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You bring together internal resources that enable you to be successful sales professional&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How You\u2019ll Grow&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a team that dares to pursue groundbreaking experiences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;As a member of our global sales organization, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory in the DACH market. Your responsibilities will include developing a robust strategy designed to drive demand and revenue.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We encourage big-picture thinking and foster an environment that embraces innovation and creativity. You will build relationships with multiple decision makers in an account and educate them on the value of Qualtrics.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Things You\u2019ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Your focus is acquiring new business and selling the Qualtrics Platform to accounts from champions all the way up to C-level&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will consult with prospects and clients on their strategic business goals&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Developing account plans for a set list of target accounts, from power maps to demand generation to closing plans&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You will establish, handle, and manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strategizing internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc on how we will create demand in the account &amp;amp; drive senior engagement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics&#39; solution offerings and the competitive landscape to assist in figuring out win-based proposals and pricing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working together is key and you will leverage support from your own Sales team, sales operations, legal, customer success, finance and more to help your customers&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We\u2019re Looking For On Your Resume&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluency in both English and German&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Technology\/Software sales experience required&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in building qualified pipeline and identifying new opportunities&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to be curious and ask questions to clients to determine opportunities for impact&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Should Know About This Team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that&#39;s a solution you can get behind.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Our Team\u2019s Favorite Perks and Benefits&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;div&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model&lt;\/strong&gt;: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. If this role excites you, we\u2019d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Opportunity:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As Senior Engineering Manager, you\u2019ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;You\u2019ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups\u2014always with strong code review and quality standards. You&#39;ll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You\u2019ll Be Doing:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be accountable for the performance of &lt;strong&gt;two&lt;\/strong&gt; distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead improvements across Grafana and R&amp;amp;D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana\u2019s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Makes You a Great Fit&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bonus Points For&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Compensation &amp;amp; More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&amp;nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI&quot;&gt;Co-create the future with us&lt;\/a&gt; as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;*&lt;em&gt;Fortune 500\u00ae is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you&#39;ll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab&#39;s most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group&#39;s success within it. You&#39;ll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You&#39;ll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security &amp;amp; Compliance, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI\/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI &amp;amp; Competitive, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We&#39;ll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you&#39;ll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer&#39;s first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab&#39;s global SME community of practice.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI\/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience with Git, CI\/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re building our SME organization within GitLab&#39;s Solutions Architecture team, and we&#39;re distributed and all-remote.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div Our platform is powered by the Mindset Graph\u2122, our AI-driven data engine that processes billions of real-time contextual, creative, environmental, and historical signals to match every ad with the most receptive audience. The result is advertising that drives meaningful outcomes for advertisers and publishers, and is more relevant for consumers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We were founded in 2008 and are headquartered in Santa Monica, California, operating in over 19 markets across North America, Europe, Japan, and Australia.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our principles guide our work every day and are as follows:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Customer-Obsessed:&lt;\/strong&gt; We\u2019re focused on advertising solutions that solve needs and drive success for clients and partners.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Make it Happen:&lt;\/strong&gt; We have a bias for action and take ownership to deliver results.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Always Innovate:&lt;\/strong&gt; We push boundaries with creativity and technology.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Foster Belonging:&lt;\/strong&gt; We ensure colleagues feel included, supported, and empowered to thrive.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;To be a part of The Mindset Company\u2122 transforming advertising, please visit &lt;a href=&quot;http:\/\/www.gumgum.com\/careers&quot;&gt;www.gumgum.com\/careers&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;The Account Director role is an individual contributor responsible for prospecting and closing sales in GumGum\u2019s market-leading contextual advertising platform. Reporting to the NSW Sales Director, this role is responsible for developing key relationships within large and mid-size agencies, with occasional managerial guidance on client calls. We require this role to work relatively autonomously while being supported by a cross-functional pre-sales team.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Account Directors have experience and deep knowledge of the online media landscape and the advertising community and have at least 6+ years of digital media experience.&amp;nbsp; The Account Director uses existing processes to solve a variety of challenging problems to deliver for clients. The role requires applying independent judgment and discretion to select appropriate options from GumGum\u2019s defined and proven products.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Note: GumGum fosters a hybrid flexible work environment. The Sales team collaborates in office 3 days per week: Tuesday-Thursday.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Achieve&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own a $3M\u2013$4M+ annual book of business across NSW, driving both renewal revenue and fresh new business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hunt for new opportunities through cold outreach, compelling presentations, RFP responses, and creative client entertainment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Grow relationships with large and mid-sized agencies into long-term, strategic partnerships&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Turn marketing-generated leads into qualified pipeline and closed deals&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Expand current clients&#39; investment by introducing them to GumGum&#39;s display and video offerings&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Become a trusted advisor to brands and agencies, understanding their goals and matching them with the right GumGum solutions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Shape our product roadmap by bringing real client insight back to the Product team&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Account Managers and cross-functional teams to make sure every proposal lands and delivers on client expectations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Skills You&#39;ll Bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A bachelor&#39;s degree in Media, Marketing, or Advertising is preferred&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;6+ years of digital advertising sales experience, with a proven track record of hitting or exceeding targets&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience managing a large book of business, plus hands-on programmatic expertise&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong, strategic relationships across Australian agencies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Confidence in Salesforce \u2014 logging meetings and calls, pulling reports, and keeping your pipeline sharp&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for building strategic client relationships&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A sharp eye for detail and organisation, plus quick problem-solving while guiding stakeholders through the process&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solid business acumen (P&amp;amp;L, COGS, revenue drivers) and the analytical judgment to craft smart solutions from data&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Learn about our benefits &amp;amp; perks package at &lt;a href=&quot;http:\/\/gumgum.com\/benefits&quot;&gt;gumgum.com\/benefits&lt;\/a&gt;. We never use chat apps, ask you to register on other recruiting sites, or request financial information, payments or purchases. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/gumgum.com\/contact&quot;&gt;Verify suspicious outreach&lt;\/a&gt; before sharing personal information.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.co.uk\">Jobs in United Kingdom<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.co.uk\/jobs\/companies\/gumgum\/account-director-digital-advertising-sales-sydney-australia-202219","tags":["Sales"],"job_types":[],"location":"Sydney, Australia","created_at":1792324522},{"slug":"forward-deployed-engineer-399947","company_name":"Hsogroupbv","title":"Forward Deployed Engineer","description":"&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h1 data-pm-slice=&quot;1 1 []&quot;&gt;Forward Deployed Engineer&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;About HSO&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HSO is a global Business Transformation Partner with deep industry expertise and a long standing strategic relationship with Microsoft. We help organisations unlock the full potential of Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, Data and AI technologies to modernise operations, accelerate innovation and deliver meaningful business outcomes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In 2026, HSO achieved Microsoft Frontier Partner status, recognising our advanced capabilities across Microsoft Cloud and AI and our ability to help customers move beyond AI experimentation into secure, governed, enterprise scale production.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;With operations across Europe, North America and Asia, we combine industry knowledge, technical excellence and a practical, people first approach to transformation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As we continue to expand our AI capabilities, we\u2019re building a new generation of customer facing engineering talent to help organisations turn the potential of AI and agentic technologies into real, measurable value.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;About the Role&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HSO is building a new generation of customer facing engineers who will help our customers create the operating model of the future using the latest AI, data and cloud capabilities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Forward Deployed Engineers combine consulting judgement, production software engineering, data platform expertise, AI delivery capability and business transformation skills.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will embed with strategic customers, understand their most important business challenges and rapidly turn those challenges into working, production ready AI applications, agentic workflows, automation solutions and data driven platforms.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a hands on, outcome led role embedded within customer environments. You\u2019ll move quickly from discovery to working software and take accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll work across business processes, data platforms, integrations, AI, cloud and security, designing solutions that make effective use of Microsoft technologies while integrating with the customer\u2019s wider technology estate.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;A strong understanding of modern enterprise data platforms is fundamental to the role. You will need to understand how data is structured, governed, integrated, transformed and made available to AI and application workloads, and how data platform decisions affect the quality, scalability and reliability of the solutions you build.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Forward Deployed Engineers work closely with Deployment Strategists. The Deployment Strategist focuses on identifying where AI can create the greatest customer value and defining the desired outcome. The FDE takes ownership of how that outcome is delivered technically.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;From discovery through to go live, both roles work side by side. The FDE owns the technical solution and delivery, while the Deployment Strategist ensures the solution remains aligned to the business problem and measurable value.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The role does not end at first deployment. You\u2019ll stay close to solutions through hardening, adoption and handover before moving on to the next value opportunity. You\u2019ll also turn what you learn into reusable HSO assets, reference architectures and delivery patterns that help future engagements move faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What You\u2019ll Do&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Own Customer Outcomes&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Embed rapidly within customer teams and develop a strong understanding of their priorities, operating processes, systems, data and constraints.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Translate ambiguous business problems and defined customer outcomes into clear technical delivery plans.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Act as the technical lead throughout an engagement, guiding customer sponsors, business users, technical teams and HSO colleagues towards successful delivery.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Build trusted relationships with senior operational and technical stakeholders, including CTO and CIO level leaders.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Take ownership for delivering solutions that create measurable customer value rather than simply completing technical tasks.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Lead Discovery and Solution Design&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customer challenges and identify high value AI, data and automation opportunities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Assess business processes, data readiness, data architecture, integration points, security requirements, technical risks and operational constraints.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Understand the customer\u2019s existing data platform landscape and identify how data needs to be accessed, transformed, governed or modernised to support the required solution.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Apply a problem first approach to identify the smallest valuable solution that can be built and proven quickly.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Design end to end solution architectures that balance speed, scalability, maintainability, security and responsible AI.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Turn discovery into a pragmatic roadmap from prototype through to production.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Build and Ship Production Solutions&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Design, build, integrate, test and deploy enterprise grade solutions using modern cloud, data and AI technologies.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Develop AI powered applications, copilots, agents, automations, integrations and workflow solutions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Build solutions that make effective use of modern enterprise data platforms and ensure AI applications are supported by reliable, governed and accessible data.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Integrate solutions with platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow and customer owned systems, APIs and data platforms.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Apply modern engineering practices including source control, CI\/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, observability and secure development.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Work iteratively. Deliver value quickly, learn from real world usage and progressively harden solutions for enterprise production.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Engineer AI and Agentic Solutions&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Design and implement robust agentic workflows, human in the loop processes and, where appropriate, multi agent architectures.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Apply modern techniques across retrieval, grounding, orchestration, tool integration, context engineering and evaluation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Build evaluation frameworks and guardrails to test AI behaviour, reliability and quality before and after deployment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Implement appropriate responsible AI, security, monitoring and governance controls.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Ensure data quality, lineage, governance and availability are considered as fundamental components of AI solution design.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Use operational data and user feedback to continuously improve solution quality and performance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Create Reusable HSO Capability&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Reuse existing HSO assets, accelerators and delivery patterns wherever they improve speed and quality.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable assets, reference architectures, engineering patterns and playbooks.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Contribute actively to HSO\u2019s AI, Data, Frontier and Horizon engineering communities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Share practical knowledge across regions, practices and delivery teams.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Support and mentor other engineers as the Forward Deployed Engineering capability grows.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What We\u2019re Looking For&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We\u2019re looking for experienced engineers who combine strong technical depth with commercial awareness and the ability to operate confidently with customers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll ideally bring:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Significant experience across software engineering, cloud engineering, data engineering, solution development, technical consulting or enterprise technology delivery, with senior level ownership of complex solutions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u2022 Strong hands on experience building and operating production grade We are optimally positioned to capitalise on strong global growth trends driven by digital adoption and regulatory expansion across lottery and iGaming markets.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p style=\"text-align:start;\"><strong>Well, what about the team?<\/strong><\/p><p>Join our AI Transformation team to create new capabilities and rethink how teams across Product and Technology work. Our programme aims to help teams ship faster, improve quality, reduce the effort and cost of delivery, build products that strengthen our competitive position, and develop our people\u2019s skills. We turn promising ideas into working products and practices that teams can adopt and reuse across the business.<\/p><p>As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be empowered to identify opportunities, propose ideas and build new products, tools and ways of working. You will take ownership of your own initiatives, from a clear hypothesis and agreed success measures through experimentation, production delivery and learning. Alongside this, you will work with engineering teams to turn their prototypes into reliable production products, own shared transformation tooling, and showcase new approaches through demos, tech talks, workshops and pairing. This role combines the creativity to see what could be different with the engineering judgement and drive to make it happen.<\/p><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p style=\"text-align:start;\"><strong>So, what will you be doing?<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p><strong>Originate and build new capabilities:<\/strong> Proactively identify opportunities across Product and Technology, turn them into practical proposals, and build products, internal tools, automations and agents that create value. Own selected initiatives from discovery through delivery, working with stakeholders to connect each idea to a clear programme outcome.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Run experiments that lead to decisions:<\/strong> State the opportunity and hypothesis, then agree the success measure and threshold before building. Create the smallest useful experiment, use a feature flag or controlled rollout where appropriate, and measure against a control or baseline at an agreed review date. Use the evidence to scale, change or stop the work.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Take prototypes into production:<\/strong> Deliver your own successful experiments and partner with engineering teams to productionise theirs. Resolve architecture, integration, testing, security and operational gaps, agree production-readiness criteria, and work through release and handover with the teams that will own and operate the resulting products.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Improve how teams build software:<\/strong> Redesign planning, development, testing, review and delivery around the capabilities of AI. Build and trial approaches such as specification-driven development and agent-assisted workflows, then turn successful work into reusable skills, reference implementations, connectors and engineering patterns that teams can adapt.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Own shared transformation tooling:<\/strong> Build and maintain the programme\u2019s shared applications, APIs, integrations and analytics on AWS, including the Radar and Tracker and connections to engineering and collaboration systems. Keep these services reliable, maintainable and useful to activity owners and programme leaders.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Champion practical AI engineering:<\/strong> Showcase emerging approaches and techniques through regular demos, tech talks, workshops, pairing and clear written guides. Share working examples, explain trade-offs and limitations, and turn successful experiments into practices that other teams can use.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Evaluate tools and approaches:<\/strong> Keep up with developments in AI engineering, test them against real team needs, and recommend adoption based on evidence. Consider quality, cost, security and portability, helping teams retain flexibility as tools, models and pricing change.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Embed quality and responsible use:<\/strong> Work with Platform, SRE, Cyber and governance colleagues to build evaluation, observability, access controls and appropriate human oversight into AI-enabled services and workflows. Help teams understand failure modes and make support, recovery and ownership arrangements clear.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Develop capability in others:<\/strong> Mentor graduate and less experienced engineers, and work with learning and enablement colleagues to address practical skills gaps. Build teams\u2019 confidence and ability to maintain what they adopt.<\/p><\/li><\/ul> <br> <p style=\"text-align:start;\"><strong>And what will you need?<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p><strong>Software engineering and delivery:<\/strong> Strong Python or TypeScript skills and experience taking prototypes into production, including APIs, cloud deployment (preferably AWS), automated testing, CI\/CD and observability.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Practical AI engineering:<\/strong> Experience building LLM applications, agents or automations, using AI coding tools effectively, and improving results through evals and error analysis. Familiarity with context, reusable skills and integrations through APIs or MCP.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Initiative and product judgement:<\/strong> Evidence of spotting opportunities, creating useful solutions without a fully defined brief, and owning delivery from idea to outcome.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Experimentation and evaluation:<\/strong> Ability to define hypotheses and success measures before building, run focused experiments against a baseline or control, and use evidence to decide what happens next.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Sound engineering judgement:<\/strong> Ability to balance quality, reliability, security and cost, evaluate AI behaviour, and choose maintainable solutions with appropriate data access and human oversight.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Technical evangelism and collaboration:<\/strong> Clear communication through demos, tech talks, workshops and written guides. Experience partnering with teams, mentoring engineers and helping others adopt effective practices.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>What benefits will you get? <\/strong>&nbsp;<\/p><ul><li><p>25 days annual leave, plus the bank holiday allowance.<\/p><\/li><li><p>Health insurance.<\/p><\/li><li><p>Volunteering days.<\/p><\/li><li><p>Home office allowance.<\/p><\/li><li><p>Wellness or Gym allowance.<\/p><\/li><li><p>Flexi-block policy allowing you to work abroad for up to four weeks a year.&nbsp;<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><p><strong>DNA \/ Values:<\/strong><\/p><p>At Bally\u2019s Intralot we are driven by a set of core values that we like to call our DNA.
