You should never send money to anyone who suggests they can provide employment with The New York Times.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you see a fake or fraudulent job posting, or if you suspect you have received a fraudulent offer, you can report it to The New York Times at ----- You can also file a report with the &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/reportfraud.ftc.gov\/#\/&quot;&gt;Federal Trade Commission&lt;\/a&gt; or your &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.naag.org\/our-work\/center-for-consumer-protection\/consumer-file-a-complaint\/&quot;&gt;state attorney general&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;<p>Find more <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.co.uk\/english-speaking-jobs\">English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.co.uk\/jobs\/companies\/thenewyorktimes\/senior-producer-reporter-video-london-4731","tags":["Video"],"job_types":[],"location":"London","created_at":1792302922},{"slug":"director-of-financial-risk-60631","company_name":"tide","title":"Director of Financial Risk","description":"&lt;div class=&quot;content-intro&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;A&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;BOUT TIDE&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Tide facts:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Over $300 million raised in funding&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;3,000 Tideans globally&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India\u2019s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;ABOUT THE ROLE:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Tide, we&#39;re building the leading financial platform for small businesses. As we continue to grow across multiple markets, strong financial risk management is essential to helping us scale safely, responsibly and sustainably.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As our &lt;strong&gt;Director of Financial Risk&lt;\/strong&gt;, you&#39;ll lead our global 2LOD Financial Risk team and shape how we identify, assess and oversee financial risks across the business. You&#39;ll own our financial risk framework while providing independent oversight, challenge and trusted advice to 1LOD teams across:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Financial Reporting &amp;amp; Control (statutory &amp;amp; regulatory accounting),&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;FP&amp;amp;A (management accounting &amp;amp; commercial finance),&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Finance Operations (including account operations, reconciliations, AP &amp;amp; AR, payroll)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Treasury&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Finance Product (systems support for Finance).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Corporate Development (for any CorDev working impacting FinRisk)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As well as the Regional Heads\/Directors of Finance that coordinate these functions for their region (UK, EU, India).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a highly visible leadership role, and you\u2019ll be at the forefront of scaling in new markets, working on new licences, and new products. We are looking for not just a deep subject matter expert, but a trusted leader to help us scale whilst managing our financial risks.&amp;nbsp; You will need to be a strong collaborator, as you&#39;ll work closely with a variety of stakeholders, from senior leadership and executives to auditors and banking partners, to ensure Tide remains financially resilient while continuing to innovate for our members.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;WHAT YOU&#39;LL BE DOING&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a global role in which you will:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own and evolve Tide&#39;s Financial Risk Management Framework, ensuring it grows with the business as we expand into new markets, launch new products and operate under new licences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide independent oversight and challenge of 1LOD activities relating to financial risks, working mostly with Finance and Treasury. You need to be deeply familiar with how a global Treasury function works, to be able to identify and manage risks arising.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure alignment of financial risk governance across all regulated entities and jurisdictions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain and enhance financial risk appetite metrics, limits, triggers, and escalation protocols.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deliver clear and independent reporting to Group and entity-level Risk &amp;amp; Compliance Committees and Boards.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monitor capital adequacy, liquidity, concentration risks, and financial resilience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support regulatory engagements, audits, thematic reviews, and licence applications.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Independently oversee treasury and liquidity management activities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Review and challenge liquidity forecasting methodologies and stress assumptions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain existing risk policies and frameworks, and develop new ones as required.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead financial risk assessments for new products, partnerships, and market launches.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with other Risk &amp;amp; Compliance teams, various Finance teams, Legal and Internal Audit teams to ensure integrated risk management.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Present concise and insightful risk reporting to Risk &amp;amp; Compliance Committees, and lead on the Financial Risk Working Groups&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead a high-performing and experienced global financial risk team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with excellent judgement and the ability to influence across the organisation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll likely have:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significant experience leading Financial Risk within fintech, payments, e-money, banking or another regulated financial services environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience operating in a 2LOD leadership role.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong knowledge of financial risk frameworks within payment institutions, e-money institutions or digital banking.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise across treasury, liquidity, solvability, capital, solvency, statutory reporting and tax risk.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Accounting expertise; ideally with an accounting qualification.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions and engaging directly with regulators and auditors.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability to balance strong risk management with commercial ambition in a fast-moving business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and provide independent challenge when it matters.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A collaborative leadership style, with experience building and developing high-performing teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Most importantly, you&#39;ll enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, be comfortable navigating change, and care about helping Tide build a resilient business that continues to deliver for our members.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;WHAT YOU\u2019LL GET IN RETURN:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive Compensation -&amp;nbsp; competitive salary and share options&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Time Off \u2013 Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Parental Leave \u2013 Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Sabbatical \u2013 Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Access to salary sacrifice benefits \u2013 like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Health Insurance \u2013 Comprehensive Private family insurance plan&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Life &amp;amp; Accident Cover \u2013 Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mental Wellbeing \u2013 Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Retirement Planning \u2013 Build your retirement fund faster with Tide\u2019s pension scheme on eligible earnings&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Volunteering &amp;amp; Development Days \u2013 Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Learning &amp;amp; Development \u2013 Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;WOO (Work Outside the Office) \u2013 Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Home Office Setup \u2013 Contribution towards setting up your home office&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Laptop Ownership \u2013 Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it\u2019s time for a replacement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Snacks &amp;amp; Meals \u2013 Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Tide, we champion a &lt;strong&gt;flexible workplace &lt;\/strong&gt;model that&lt;strong&gt; &lt;\/strong&gt;supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. This role is based in our London office with a &lt;strong&gt;hybrid&lt;\/strong&gt; setup, typically 3 days in the office.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Get to know our &lt;a class=&quot;ng-star-inserted&quot; href=&quot;https:\/\/careers.deliveroo.co.uk\/software-engineering-at-deliveroo\/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Engineering&lt;\/a&gt; team \u2014 what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div style=&quot;min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a BI Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the models, systems and automation behind our BI platforms. This will include supporting our extensive user base on our current BI stack (primarily Looker and Sigma) while helping shape a single, more integrated BI platform across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you&#39;re energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You\u2019re excited about this opportunity because you will\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Own and evolve the semantic layer behind our BI platforms: LookML and Canvas BI models, metric and dimension definitions, and the governance that keeps them trusted&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Build and operate the Looker and Sigma platforms themselves: instance and workspace configuration, permissions and user attributes, content lifecycle, and API-driven automation&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Lead the development of self-serve tooling that removes manual BI administration, using usage analytics to decide what to automate, build or retire next&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Support BI platform migrations and deprecations across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt while protecting access, governance, data integrity and business continuity&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Take part in operational support, production debugging and incident response for the BI stack, and fix the root causes you find&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Champion engineering standards in BI, including version control, code review, CI and testing for models and platform code, so changes ship safely and repeatably&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;We\u2019re excited about you because\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;3+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar code-first data role&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Strong Python and SQL skills, and hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) to accelerate your own engineering work&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Hands-on experience building in a BI platform such as Looker (LookML) or Sigma, modelling and configuring it, not only building dashboards in it&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience with semantic or metrics layers (LookML, dbt or similar): defining metrics and dimensions, and keeping those definitions consistent as they are reused&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience running what you build in production: version control, code review, CI, debugging live issues and taking part in operational support&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Excellent communication skills, and comfortable self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment with both technical and non-technical teams&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nice to Have&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience with modern data warehousing platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift) and ability to optimize performance&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience automating BI administration through platform APIs, or identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience supporting a BI stack across multiple brands, tenants or regions, or leading a BI platform migration&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Why Join Us?&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Deliveroo, you\u2019ll do work that matters\u2014solving We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot; data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;An award-winning workplace&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;You can be a part of our \u2018Great Place to Work\u2019 \u2013 with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all.\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.baringa.com\/en\/impact\/awards\/&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Click here&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202fto see some of our recent awards and how we\u2019ve achieved this.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Using business as a force for good.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:200,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Join us&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&amp;nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI&quot;&gt;Co-create the future with us&lt;\/a&gt; as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;*&lt;em&gt;Fortune 500\u00ae is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you&#39;ll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab&#39;s most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group&#39;s success within it. You&#39;ll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You&#39;ll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security &amp;amp; Compliance, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI\/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI &amp;amp; Competitive, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We&#39;ll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you&#39;ll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer&#39;s first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab&#39;s global SME community of practice.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI\/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience with Git, CI\/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud C\u2019est l\u00e0 que le m\u00e9tier se joue vraiment, et c\u2019est ce qu\u2019on attend de toi du premier jour au dernier.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Tu passes du prototype \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9chelle.<\/strong> POC, MVP, pipelines industriels : tu sais quand il faut aller vite et quand il faut consolider, en gardant l\u2019enjeu business en ligne de mire.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Tu travailles au contact direct du m\u00e9tier.<\/strong> Product Managers, \u00e9quipes Data, MLOps, et surtout le client. Tu expliques ce que fait le mod\u00e8le, ce qu\u2019il ne fait pas, et pourquoi. <\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Tu fais monter les autres.<\/strong> Acculturation IA des \u00e9quipes internes et des \u00e9quipes clientes, partage de ce que tu as appris en atelier, contribution \u00e0 la practice Agents IA.<\/p><\/li><li><p><strong>Tu participes \u00e0 la vie d\u2019Hubvisory.<\/strong> Tu consolides ta posture de consultant.e et tu \u00e9volues, selon tes aspirations, vers des r\u00f4les de r\u00e9f\u00e9rent.e technique, Lead IA ou Architecte Gen-AI.<\/p><p><br><\/p><\/li><\/ul><p>\ud83d\udc49 <strong>Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?<\/strong><\/p><ul><li><p>Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalis\u00e9 exclusivement sur le Product Management et l\u2019IA. style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>Nature de l\u2019emploi&nbsp;: Doctorat<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"><strong>Lieu de travail&nbsp;: Strasbourg \/ Douai<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"><strong><u>Contexte&nbsp;:<\/u><\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Le doctorat s\u2019inscrit dans le cadre d\u2019une collaboration scientifique entre le Centre d\u2019Enseignement, Recherche et Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) d\u2019IMT Nord Europe et l\u2019UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA&nbsp;: ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Proc\u00e9d\u00e9s pour l\u2019Energie, l\u2019Environnement et la Sant\u00e9) dont l\u2019objectif est de renseigner l\u2019influence des pluies sur les d\u00e9p\u00f4ts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des donn\u00e9es existantes dans l\u2019air ambiant.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>L\u2019IMT Nord Europe<\/strong> est une \u00e9cole sous tutelle du minist\u00e8re de l\u2019\u00e9conomie, des finances et de la souverainet\u00e9 industrielle et num\u00e9rique. IMT Nord Europe est n\u00e9e en 2017 de la fusion de T\u00e9l\u00e9com Lille et de l\u2019\u00c9cole des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd\u2019hui parmi les plus Grandes \u00c9coles d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 \u00e9l\u00e8ves, dont un quart d\u2019apprentis, plus de 600 dipl\u00f4m\u00e9s par an et un r\u00e9seau de 15 000 dipl\u00f4m\u00e9s. Elle fait partie de l\u2019Institut Mines T\u00e9l\u00e9com, premier groupe public de Grandes \u00c9coles d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l\u2019universit\u00e9 de Lille.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ing\u00e9nieurs responsables aptes \u00e0 r\u00e9soudre les grandes probl\u00e9matiques du XXI\u00e8me si\u00e8cle ; mener des recherches d\u00e9bouchant sur des innovations \u00e0 haute valeur ajout\u00e9e ; soutenir le d\u00e9veloppement des territoires notamment en facilitant l\u2019innovation et les cr\u00e9ations d\u2019entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ing\u00e9nieurs de demain, ma\u00eetrisant \u00e0 la fois les technologies num\u00e9riques et les savoir-faire industriels. Id\u00e9alement situ\u00e9e au carrefour de l\u2019Europe, \u00e0 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l\u2019ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, num\u00e9riques et environnementales du XXI\u00e8me si\u00e8cle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l\u2019ing\u00e9nieur et les technologies du digital.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Localis\u00e9e sur 2 sites principaux d\u2019enseignement et de recherche, \u00e0 Lille et \u00e0 Douai, IMT Nord Europe s\u2019appuie sur plus de 20 000 m\u00b2 de laboratoire pour d\u00e9velopper un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d\u2019excellence dans les trois domaines \u00ab&nbsp;Syst\u00e8mes Num\u00e9riques&nbsp;\u00bb, \u00ab&nbsp;Energie Environnement&nbsp;\u00bb et \u00ab&nbsp;Mat\u00e9riaux et Proc\u00e9d\u00e9s&nbsp;\u00bb.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Le CERI EE d\u2019IMT Nord Europe d\u00e9veloppe des activit\u00e9s au c\u0153ur des transitions \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orient\u00e9e vers les sciences de l'atmosph\u00e8re, la qualit\u00e9 des environnements int\u00e9rieurs et les enjeux de l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et de la d\u00e9carbonation. La candidate\/le candidat int\u00e9grera l\u2019un des 3 axes th\u00e9matiques du CERI EE, l\u2019axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosph\u00e9riques).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Pour plus de d\u00e9tails, consulter le site internet de l\u2019\u00c9cole : <u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"http:\/\/www.imt-lille-douai.fr\/\">www.imt-nord-europe.fr<\/a><\/u> et celui du CERI EE <u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr\/energie-environnement-ceri\">https:\/\/recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr\/energie-environnement-ceri<\/a><\/u><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>L\u2019ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Proc\u00e9d\u00e9s pour l'Energie, l'Environnement et la Sant\u00e9, UMR 7515 du CNRS et de l\u2019Universit\u00e9 de Strasbourg)<\/strong> a \u00e9t\u00e9 cr\u00e9\u00e9 en janvier 2013 lorsque deux laboratoires, le Laboratoire des mat\u00e9riaux, surfaces et proc\u00e9d\u00e9s pour la catalyse (LMSPC) et le Laboratoire d'ing\u00e9nierie des polym\u00e8res pour les hautes technologies (LIPHT), d\u00e9cident de fusionner. Lors de la fusion, les trois \u00e9quipes du LIPHT et les sept \u00e9quipes du LMSPC ont \u00e9t\u00e9 structur\u00e9es en trois d\u00e9partements de recherche : catalyse et mat\u00e9riaux, chimie mol\u00e9culaire et analytique, ing\u00e9nierie des polym\u00e8res.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">La transversalit\u00e9 des comp\u00e9tences pr\u00e9sentes au sein de l\u2019Institut permet de traiter des probl\u00e9matiques globales allant de la synth\u00e8se des mol\u00e9cules \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9laboration de l\u2019objet final pour des applications li\u00e9es \u00e0 l'Energie, l'Environnement ou la Sant\u00e9. L\u2019implication forte des \u00e9quipes de l\u2019unit\u00e9 dans les recherches fondamentales avec une vis\u00e9e applicative a permis au laboratoire de se positionner sur l\u2019ensemble de la cha\u00eene de valeur et d\u2019acqu\u00e9rir une renomm\u00e9e internationale. Les collaborations acad\u00e9miques tant nationales qu\u2019internationales ont contribu\u00e9 aussi aux d\u00e9veloppements de nouveaux axes de recherche inexploit\u00e9s \u00e0 l\u2019heure actuelle. Les d\u00e9veloppements avals des recherches men\u00e9es au sein de l\u2019unit\u00e9 ont \u00e9galement permis de tisser de nombreuses collaborations avec le monde socio-\u00e9conomique en apportant des solutions concr\u00e8tes aux diff\u00e9rentes demandes soci\u00e9tales et en d\u00e9veloppant de nouveaux proc\u00e9d\u00e9s en ad\u00e9quation avec les nouvelles l\u00e9gislations.&nbsp;<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Les activit\u00e9s de recherche au sein de l\u2019unit\u00e9 ne peuvent \u00eatre men\u00e9es d\u2019une mani\u00e8re sereine, sans l\u2019appui fort des p\u00f4les de soutien \u00e0 la recherche, qui ont permis de fluidifier les demandes techniques et administratives. L\u2019excellente coh\u00e9sion entre ces p\u00f4les et les \u00e9quipes de recherche a contribu\u00e9 \u00e9galement \u00e0 mieux anticiper des probl\u00e8mes \u00e9ventuels et \u00e0 d\u2019optimiser le fonctionnement quotidien au sein de l\u2019unit\u00e9. En 2020, la direction de l\u2019ICPEES a organis\u00e9 le service commun technique en 3 p\u00f4les : le P\u00f4le Caract\u00e9risation, le P\u00f4le Ing\u00e9nierie et D\u00e9veloppement et le P\u00f4le Chimie.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Pour plus de d\u00e9tails, consulter le site internet de l\u2019ICPEES :<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/icpees.unistra.fr\">https:\/\/icpees.unistra.fr<\/a><\/u><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"><strong><u>Missions<\/u>&nbsp;:<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Le doctorant aura pour mission d\u2019\u00e9valuer la dynamique des d\u00e9p\u00f4ts atmosph\u00e9riques de pesticides \u00e0 diff\u00e9rentes \u00e9chelles spatiales et temporelles en collaboration avec l\u2019observatoire MERA (<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-mera\">https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-mera<\/a><\/u>) et les AASQA (<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.atmo-france.org\/\">https:\/\/www.atmo-france.org\/<\/a><\/u>) sur le territoire national. Dans un premier temps, il devra adapter les m\u00e9thodes d\u2019analyse de pesticides existantes en GC\/MSMS et LC\/MSMS dans l\u2019\u00e9quipe \u00ab&nbsp;CAMATES (<strong>C<\/strong>himie <strong>A<\/strong>nalytique <strong>MAT<\/strong>\u00e9riaux, <strong>E<\/strong>nvironnement <strong>S<\/strong>ant\u00e9)&nbsp;\u00bb de l\u2019ICPEES (UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA), en particulier int\u00e9grer les pesticides de la liste prioritaire de l\u2019ANSES<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"#_ftn1\">[1]<\/a><\/u> et ceux du dispositif Pesticides coordonn\u00e9 par le LCSQA<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"#_ftn2\">[2]<\/a><\/u> (<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-pesticides\">https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-pesticides<\/a><\/u>). Il aura \u00e9galement pour mission de d\u00e9terminer la m\u00e9thode technique d\u2019extraction de ces mol\u00e9cules et de quantifier l\u2019effet de matrice\/interf\u00e9rences potentiels que peuvent g\u00e9n\u00e9rer les eaux pluviales et les d\u00e9p\u00f4ts secs. Pour cela, il disposera d\u2019\u00e9chantillons r\u00e9els de d\u00e9p\u00f4ts totaux (humides et secs) qu\u2019il dopera avec des mol\u00e9cules non pr\u00e9sentes dans les \u00e9chantillons et des \u00e9talons marqu\u00e9s.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Il aura ensuite la t\u00e2che d\u2019analyser les \u00e9chantillons de d\u00e9p\u00f4ts atmosph\u00e9riques collect\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re hebdomadaire pendant 1 an sur plusieurs sites d\u2019\u00e9tude et \u00e9galement de quantifier si la r\u00e9frig\u00e9ration des \u00e9chantillons pendant leur stockage dans le pr\u00e9leveur est indispensable.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Enfin, il aura \u00e0 interpr\u00e9ter et analyser les r\u00e9sultats en termes d\u2019occurrence, de variabilit\u00e9 spatiale et temporelle (influence de l\u2019activit\u00e9 agricole), de relation avec les conditions m\u00e9t\u00e9orologiques (trajectoire des masses d\u2019air) et de corr\u00e9lation avec d\u2019autres polluants atmosph\u00e9riques ou des mesures de pesticides dans l\u2019air ambiant r\u00e9alis\u00e9es en parall\u00e8le par les AASQA.<\/p><p Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers \u00e0 acc\u00e9der instantan\u00e9ment \u00e0 une information fiable, sourc\u00e9e \u00e0 partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;D\u00e9j\u00e0 d\u00e9ploy\u00e9 avec succ\u00e8s en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage \u00e0 l&#39;\u00e9chelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des \u00e9valuations, am\u00e9lioration continue de nos mod\u00e8les et de leurs qualit\u00e9s et d\u00e9ploiement et int\u00e9gration d\u2019agents autonomes RH.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e d\u00e9veloppeur.se, nous avons besoin d&#39;un.e &quot;&lt;strong&gt;Builder&lt;\/strong&gt;&quot; : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin m\u00e9tier en solution technique, de l\u2019impl\u00e9menter, la qualifier, la d\u00e9ployer et la maintenir dans le temps.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;\ud83c\udfaf VOTRE MISSION&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous recherchons un(e) &lt;strong&gt;AI Engineer confirm\u00e9(e)&lt;\/strong&gt; pour participer activement \u00e0 l&#39;industrialisation et au d\u00e9veloppement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins m\u00e9tiers RH en fonctionnalit\u00e9s IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour relever ce d\u00e9fi, vous \u00e9voluerez au &lt;strong&gt;sein d&#39;un collectif d\u00e9di\u00e9&lt;\/strong&gt;, en collaboration directe avec d&#39;autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d&#39;architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximit\u00e9 vous permettra d&#39;assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l&#39;impl\u00e9mentation technique.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Vous aurez notamment un r\u00f4le cl\u00e9 dans l&#39;\u00e9volution de DaiLY : passer d&#39;un mod\u00e8le de simple consultation (Q&amp;amp;A) \u00e0 un &lt;strong&gt;v\u00e9ritable syst\u00e8me agentique transactionnel&lt;\/strong&gt; capable de d\u00e9clencher des actions concr\u00e8tes (ex : poser des cong\u00e9s dans Workday, s&#39;inscrire \u00e0 des formations via Decathlon University).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83d\udee0 VOS RESPONSABILITES&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9veloppement Agentique &amp;amp; Fonctionnalit\u00e9s&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participer \u00e0 l&#39;extension des capacit\u00e9s de DaiLY vers des actions d&#39;\u00e9criture (write actions) en impl\u00e9mentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Impl\u00e9menter des strat\u00e9gies avanc\u00e9es de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les r\u00e8gles sp\u00e9cifiques au domaine RH.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribuer \u00e0 l&#39;optimisation des co\u00fbts, de la latence et de l&#39;efficacit\u00e9 globale du syst\u00e8me en lien avec les \u00e9quipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Qualit\u00e9, \u00c9valuation &amp;amp; Observabilit\u00e9 (LLMOps)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9velopper et maintenir la couche de qualit\u00e9 du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search \/ Discovery Engine).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des r\u00e9ponses et la v\u00e9rification des citations pour garantir la tra\u00e7abilit\u00e9 vers une source de v\u00e9rit\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mettre en place des pipelines d&#39;observabilit\u00e9 robustes pour l&#39;\u00e9valuation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coder des \u00e9valuateurs automatiques bas\u00e9s sur des golden datasets pour it\u00e9rer sereinement et pr\u00e9venir les r\u00e9gressions avant chaque mise en production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Int\u00e9grer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour prot\u00e9ger le syst\u00e8me et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;S\u00e9curit\u00e9, Cloisonnement &amp;amp; In addition to direct partnerships with governments, we also work with implementing partners, including the US CDC, the World Health Organization, the World Bank, and the Global Health Advocacy Incubator, to implement programs, prototype innovations, and ensure sustainability through increased national ownership, including domestic budget allocations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Position Purpose&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;auto&quot;&gt;The Senior Technical Advisor, Data Use and Decision Science, focuses on bridging the gap between complex epidemiological and contextual data and strategic public health action. This role will accompany in-country counterparts to generate stronger analytics and information products to support decision-making, integrating disease surveillance data with other contextual (e.g., climate, environmental, risk, and vulnerability) data. The role will also contribute to the facilitation of two flagship programs - Epidemic Intelligence training curriculum and a co-design workshop - to build national counterparts&#39; capacity for epidemic intelligence and systems thinking. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, &lt;u&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/cts.businesswire.com\/ct\/CT?id=smartlink&amp;amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;amp;esheet=54451094&amp;amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;amp;lan=en-US&amp;amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;amp;index=11&amp;amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;setting a world record in quantum computing performance&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/u&gt;.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1893&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Senior Manager reporting to the Senior Manager, Hardware, to lead the people and the execution of our cryptographic engineering team. This team builds post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for our quantum-safe product portfolio, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. This is a people-leadership and delivery role: you will manage and develop a team of 8+ highly specialised engineers, own programme execution, and partner closely with the programme\u2019s senior technical leadership, who own the architecture and technical direction. It is an opportunity to lead exceptional people on a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will manage engineers spanning applied cryptography, RTL and FPGA design, firmware and protocols, verification, QA and security certification: recruiting and onboarding, coaching and career development, objective setting, performance management and retention, building a high-performing and collaborative engineering culture. You will own execution of the programme: planning and milestones, dependency and risk management, resource allocation, budget ownership\/management, and clear reporting to executive stakeholders. You will put in place the engineering processes the team runs on (development workflow, reviews, tooling, lab operations), remove blockers, and coordinate with talent acquisition, HR, product management, certification bodies, IP vendors and customers. As a Machine Learning Certification Researcher, you will address one of the most fundamental challenges in modern AI: proving that ML models are safe, reliable, and mathematically sound for deployment in autonomous flight. Your work will bridge the gap between cutting-edge statistical learning theory and formal aviation certification frameworks, building upon previous work (EASA CoDANN I and II, and FAA report DOT\/FAA\/TC-21\/48), and putting real-world systems to the test.<\/p><p>At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision\u2014developing safety-critical AI systems at the intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive, understand, and make decisions in real time, we combine aerospace engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight systems, driving innovation where it matters most.<\/p><p><strong>What You'll Do<\/strong><\/p><p>\u2022 AI Certification Strategy: Analyze our existing AI certification strategy and help adapt it\u2014or pioneer entirely new strategies\u2014to certify different supervised ML.<\/p><p>\u2022 EASA Framework Alignment: Connect mathematical guarantees, technical arguments, and model evaluations to the EASA W-shaped process for AI certification in aviation, ensuring our research aligns with the latest regulatory guidelines.<\/p><p>\u2022 Theoretical Foundation &amp; Modeling: Conduct research into statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and mathematical guarantees for deep neural networks operating under dynamic real-world conditions.<\/p><p>\u2022 Uncertainty Quantification: Apply statistics and stochastic processes to model environmental uncertainties and sensor noise, and to quantify confidence in performance metrics.<\/p><p>\u2022 Literature &amp; Proof Evaluation: Critically evaluate academic literature, mathematical proofs, and engineering assumptions with peer-review rigor to identify safety limitations and theoretical gaps in state-of-the-art AI.<\/p><p>\u2022 Regulatory &amp; Audit Justification: Construct robust, logical arguments and technical justifications that translate complex, high-dimensional empirical data into structured evidence for safety audits and certification frameworks.<\/p><p>\u2022 Algorithmic Validation: Write clean, reproducible code in Python to test theoretical hypotheses, validate certification mechanisms, and benchmark model safety frameworks.<\/p><p><strong>Requirements<\/strong><\/p><p><strong>What You'll Need<\/strong><\/p><p><strong>Machine Learning Theory &amp; Mathematics<\/strong><\/p><p>\u2022 ML Theory &amp; Statistical Learning: Deep understanding of statistical learning theory, generalization bounds, and the mathematical foundations of deep neural networks.<\/p><p>\u2022 Statistics &amp; You report to the Executive Director, IT Enterprise Applications in the US, and partner closely with International business leaders and US-based IT counterparts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own the International application and technology roadmap and business relationship, for Commercial and Medical Affairs systems including Veeva CRM, Databricks, and Analytics, while ensuring alignment with enterprise owned platforms managed by US teams. Summit\u2019s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Summit\u2019s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit\u2019s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10.5pt;&quot;&gt;Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-size: 10.5pt;&quot;&gt;Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Overview of Role:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role and Reporting&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and maintain reporting frameworks, dashboards and KPI tracking tools for the Luxury business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide visibility on performance across auctions, private sales and client development activities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Produce regular business reviews and performance reporting for the Luxury and Swiss leadership team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monitor key performance indicators and highlight trends, opportunities and areas requiring attention.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Conduct pre-sale, during-sale and post-sale analyses to support business discussions and future planning.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop auction intelligence reporting and market insights to support decision-making.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Analyse bidding activity, buyer participation, conversion metrics and international selling patterns.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop auction and sales performance reporting on the Luxury and Switzerland&#39;s contribution to the wider Sotheby&#39;s business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Translate complex business data into actionable insights and recommendations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Process Improvement, Automation &amp;amp; Data Enablement&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing business visibility, reporting capabilities and operational efficiency.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes through automation and AI-enabled solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with P&amp;amp;T teams to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the implementation and adoption of new tools, processes and reporting frameworks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to cross-functional projects requiring coordination, analysis and stakeholder engagement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Help reduce manual reporting activities and improve scalability through process optimisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Leadership Reporting &amp;amp; Communications&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prepare executive-level presentations, business reviews and strategic updates for Luxury and Swiss leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Translate complex analyses into clear, concise and actionable business insights.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Produce materials that support leadership discussions, planning and decision-making.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop presentation materials for senior management meetings and business reviews.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Facilitate communication across functions to ensure alignment on reporting, priorities and objectives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure stakeholders have timely access to relevant performance, client and market insights.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;IDEAL EXPERIENCE &amp;amp; GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&amp;nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI&quot;&gt;Co-create the future with us&lt;\/a&gt; as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;*&lt;em&gt;Fortune 500\u00ae is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you&#39;ll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab&#39;s most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group&#39;s success within it. You&#39;ll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You&#39;ll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security &amp;amp; Compliance, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI\/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI &amp;amp; Competitive, you&#39;ll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We&#39;ll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you&#39;ll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer&#39;s first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab&#39;s global SME community of practice.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI\/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience with Git, CI\/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Met jouw kennis zet je rock-solid oplossingen neer bij onze klanten, stuk voor stuk indrukwekkende spelers die jou een unieke inkijk geven in hun business (van shopfloor tot data verbinden aan een organisatie die gaat voor de lange termijn.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Oftewel: jij zoekt uitdaging om je te ontwikkelen en om je loopbaan verder vorm te geven.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Je beschikt over&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Een afgeronde HBO- of WO opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van Engineering (Industrial of logistics), Supply Chain Management of een vergelijkbare opleiding;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Minimaal 5+ jaar ervaring als ERP-consultant of in een functie waarin je intensief hebt gewerkt met ERP binnen het productie domein;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span data-olk-copy-source=&quot;MessageBody&quot;&gt;Ervaring met diverse grondvormen (ETO, MTO, MTS, ATO, CTO);&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;span data-olk-copy-source=&quot;MessageBody&quot;&gt;Ervaring met zowel discrete- als procesindustrie&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deze kennis en ervaring heb je bij voorkeur aangevuld met ervaring in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management of een vergelijkbaar ERP systeem;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wat bieden we jou?&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij:\u202f&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daarbovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken;\u202f&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;\u202f&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget \u2013 we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote;\u202f&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;\u202f&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag \u00e9\u00e9n start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.\u202f\u202f&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Over HSO\u202f\u202f&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland.
